title: LIBERO Rollback Case v1
description: A model-independent rollback scenario definition. Execution results are excluded. The optional relation_stage/case_class/object_role/state_kind/params_text fields are R3 GOAL metadata; R2 cases remain valid because every added field is optional.

suite.description: Released suite label. LIBERO-10 keeps the historical hyphenated value used by the first 524 cases; the cross-suite expansion adds the LIBERO-GOAL, LIBERO-OBJECT and LIBERO-90 report labels.

task_id.description: Task identity: libero_10/0N for the official LIBERO-10 tasks, libero_10/k8_* for candidate LIBERO-10 tasks, and the base-task key for the LIBERO-GOAL/OBJECT/90 suites.

task_index.description: Position in the official LIBERO-10 task list; null for candidate LIBERO-10 tasks and for every non-LIBERO-10 task.

window.description: Free-text description of when the injection happens, in the words of the source material.

time_point.description: Structured runtime time point: early = first completed subgoal just confirmed; mid = robot withdrawn and turning to the next step; later = the closing or next action is under way; all_done = every goal predicate already holds (completion boundary).

oneOf.description: A completed articulation goal (Close / Turnon) revoked at its joint.
Legacy generated case whose relation is resolved by the task profile.

target_subgoal.description: Explicit installed runtime subgoal ID; must match declared actor and predicate.
Explicit installed runtime subgoal ID; must match declared actor and predicate.
Explicit installed runtime subgoal ID; must match declared actor and predicate.
Explicit installed runtime subgoal ID; must match declared actor and predicate.

oneOf.description: Legacy generated case whose actor and relation are resolved by the task profile.

severity.description: Position/mechanism label. d0..d3 and checkpoint are the historical labels already released in 1.0.0/1.1.0; p3/p5/p8/p10 move away from the robot, n3/n5/n8 move towards it, above is the container-hover destination and articulation marks an articulation-goal rollback.

transient.description: Second state write after the injection. `pre_injection` restores the pose the object held before the first write, so the revoked relation is briefly true again (transient failure); `initial_offset` performs a second revocation while recovery is under way.

pose_role.description: Optional pose perturbation label such as roll or spin.

reference_role.description: Optional relation reference object moved by a reference-object case.

clone_of.description: Case ID of the released LIBERO-10 case this definition was cloned from; null for project-authored all_done extension cases that have no single clone source.

needs_review.description: Boolean flag or an explicit conditional-feasibility note; both forms occur in the reviewed dependency grids.

dependency.description: Dependency marker for tasks whose target relation shares a container or support endpoint with another native goal relation. Runtime pre/post truth must classify the case as rollback, control or coupled.

pseudo_completed_goals.description: Native goal atoms that are already true at episode start (pseudo-success), so revoking them does not undo a robot-completed subgoal.

review_note.description: Review decision recorded while auditing this case definition.

relation_stage.description: R3 metadata: which completed sub-goal relation stage the intervention targets (s1 = first completed, s2 = second completed, both = atomic pair).

case_class.description: R3 metadata: main-set rollback (rev), truth probe (probe) or relation-preserving control (control). Mirrors expected_evaluation_semantics.

object_role.description: R3 metadata: which relation endpoint is perturbed (goal object, other/reference endpoint, or both endpoints together).

state_kind.description: R3 metadata: the kind of state write, normalized across mechanisms.

params_text.description: R3 metadata: human-readable parameters (init, x+3,y+5, lift12, tipX+45, setback1.0, cl6, in+x3). case_id uses an ID-safe encoding of the same values.

setback.description: Joint travel away from the completed position, in metres for slide joints and radians for hinge joints.

joint_range_rad.description: Installed joint range read from the LIBERO-plus task source.

lift_m.description: Vertical lift applied before the rotation. A completion-pose probe that only rotates intersects the container walls, so the object is raised first; the lift is kept small enough that the object stays inside the goal region.

restore.description: episode_initial_joint_position restores the episode-initial joint endpoint; explicit_joint_position targets joint_target_rad instead, which is required for pseudo-success tasks whose :init already satisfies the goal.
